create_dataset_make_regression: create a synthetic regression dataset with make_regression specifying n_samples, n_features, n_informative, noise, and coef
fit_ard_regression: fit an ARDRegression model with compute_score and max_iter to recover sparse coefficients from noisy data
fit_bayesian_ridge: fit a BayesianRidge model with compute_score and max_iter to regularize regression coefficients toward zero
plot_coefficients_heatmap: plot a heatmap of model coefficients using seaborn with SymLogNorm for true, ARD, BayesianRidge, and OLS weights
fit_polynomial_regression_pipeline: fit ARDRegression and BayesianRidge via a pipeline with PolynomialFeatures and StandardScaler on non-linear data
